info.title: Synapta API
info.description: Event-oriented AI generation backend. Manages events, programs, pieces, AI content generation, files, ingredients, presets, skills, and agency orchestration.

get.description: Merged catalog: 'api' models (static, external providers) and 'downloaded' models (read live from the inference worker; absent when the worker is unreachable — header X-Worker-Status: unreachable). Nothing is cached.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by model type; omit for merged view

get.description: Reads worker telemetry and catalog live on every call (no cache). Reports reachability, device and model count. connected=false when the worker is unreachable.

get.summary: Get event with full program/piece tree

post.summary: Sync an external asset to a model

bearerAuth.description: JWT token from POST /auth/login. Carries sub (user id), tenant_id, role_level, username.

duplicate.description: True if a file with same sha256 already existed

name.description: Stable identifier sent in generation requests

modality.description: Empty when the worker mode has no Synapta modality yet (e.g. tts)

type.description: api = external provider; downloaded = runs on the inference worker

DownloadedModel.description: Live details reported by the inference worker; never cached by Synapta.

available.description: false when the worker lists the model but cannot run it
